body: Separate narrow Layers source request, independent of Save As. A reviewer confirmed successful caller-owned Layers backend installs via DocumentWorkspace.load -> install -> select -> app.viewMode=.document while AppModel still holds recipe-read reservation. That rejected internal navigation overwrites a newer status with Wait even though pending Layers intent was cancelled and final mayShowInstalled is false. Add default-true activateDocument (or equivalent explicit mode-publication option) along editInLayers -> load -> install -> select. With false, still install/select current document internally but do not assign AppModel view mode; default behavior and open() unchanged. AppModel already finishes gate then explicitly requests .document only for installed && matching intent. Supply exact API plus tests-first/product separate commits, isolated from Save As patches. A will opt in false in its recovery candidate and validate held-backend selection/newer-status regression. No AppModel edits on B, builds/tests/apps/heartbeat/writer changes. Source-only, A owns main. Do not couple navigation policy invisibly to statusPublication enum. Preserve backend settlement and cleanup exactly once.
